title: gateway_centric flag may be stale after parent removal
description: File: python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py, Line 214-215. gateway_centric is set from the last processed DIO but never cleared when that neighbor is removed. If the preferred parent changes to one that did not set gateway_centric, the stale flag persists. Consider resetting gateway_centric in select_parent() or tracking it per-parent.
